title.value: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants
title.justification: The title 'GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants' clearly reflects the focus of the paper on using reinforcement learning to control plant growth, which is integral to its proposed environment.
title.quote: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants

extractions.description: This paper introduces GrowSpace, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark environment designed to simulate and control the growth of plants in response to light manipulation. The objective is to train agents to guide plant growth towards specific goals by adjusting a light source. The environment uses the Space Colonization Algorithm to model plant growth based on phototropism, allowing for experiments on control, hierarchical learning, fairness, and multi-objective learning. GrowSpace is meant to address real-world challenges in plant science and RL by providing a simulated platform for controlled plant growth studies.
